en: Oh yes, old one, Hakkar has returned. Soon the world shall crumble beneath his might. Consumed. Left in ruin...
Is that the best you can do?
Ah, you there!  I have tasks to give, and I need not waste time explaining their crucial nature.  Listen close.
One of the Ash'ari Crystals has been destroyed!  Slay the intruders!
The Stonewrought Dam has been saved!  Three cheers for $n!
Be safe, Antonio.
Mommy? Can I pet Fizzles?
Where can I find bone fragments?
What a great day for racing! Oh, who am I kidding? Every day's a great day for racing!
Could I have a copy of "The Feast of Winter Veil" to read?
Now go back home where you belong!
Celebras, I lost my Scepter...
I am the latest incarnation of automated vendors... we will rule the world one day... don't tell my boss that I am skimming money off his merchandise...
Head on over to the Blue Recluse. Where everybody knows your name!
Soon we shall bring about the return of the old gods.
Think you the master is daunted by your games? We will never fall to you!
Maybe... you could carry me?
Your mind is unfocused.  Are you hiding something from me?
The Snowfall Graveyard is under attack!  If left unchecked, the Horde will capture it!
%s lets out a shriek, calling for help!
Oh, how positively delightful!
Open your mind, wanderer, and we shall begin.
I'm just a student myself, really. Rhiannon's the expert. She's standing by the crates over there. You can learn a lot from her.
I cannot help you until you have learned more of the essentials. Come back to me when you are ready.
If I did not know better I would think that you were mocking me, mortal; but yes, that is mostly correct. You may remain fully clothed.

Ye learn fast $g lad : lass;, much faster than I can keep up with. If ye want ta continue yer training, I suggest ye see my teacher. His name's Rotgath, Rotgath Stonebeard and ye'll find him in Ironforge at The Great Forge.
I hope ye didn't come all the way to the Great Forge just to stay warm. Speak up $g lad : lass;, tell me what it is I can do for ye?
Continue please.
Our master Malfurion remains lost in the Dreaming, $c.  His is the light of a beacon that shows the way for us, and we must do everything in our power to preserve that light.

Food, now there's a subject that I can sink my fangs into! I am told that we have $2095w of $2096w lean wolf steaks, $2102w out of $2103w spotted yellowtail, and $2105w of $2106w baked salmon on ice and stored away.
I'm afraid not, $n. Now, feel the shame you have brought upon yourself.
The numbers of my companions dwindles, goddess, and my own power shall soon be insufficient to hold back the demons of Felwood.
Greetings, $c.  I am Exzhal, Servitor of Rastakhan.

Ah, that's sweet of you mon, but we already got all the heavy leather that we need. And here I'm sure that your knife is still sharp. Maybe you can put it to use helping the others with their collections, no?  Have a good one!

As the toxins lurking within Maraudon seeped into my mind, I began to lose my grip on reality. Worried that it would be used for evil, my dryad sisters secretly took the scepter from me, breaking it into two parts and hiding it within the caverns.$B$BSoon they fell victim to the madness as well, and the two parts of the scepter, left unguarded, came to be in the possession of Vyletongue, himself. The satyr entrusted one part to Noxxion, an evil elemental, and the other he still has to this day.

It's all over 'cept for the crying now. All of the war materiel is being transported to Cenarion Hold in Silithus, and will be there in less than $2113w days. Shouldn't be much longer until the scepter is assembled and the war finally begins.
The assassins are over here! Quickly, before they reach the Magistrate!
You're not only wasting the time of your fellow students, you're wasting my time too.
Och! Ye seek training in the way of the warrior, do ye?  Kelstrum Stonebreaker will put ye through yer paces!  Just march yerself over to the Hall of Arms east of the gates of Ironforge.

The battle rages, and both our captain and the captain of our enemy are slain!$B$BDrek'Thar now leads us from Frostwolf Keep, and the dwarf Vanndar Stormpike hides deep in Dun Baldar.  Defeat Vanndar and claim victory for the Horde!
Crybaby! Crybaby!
Don't forget the orphans of Stormwind!

Here in Darnassus you will find skilled trainers who have perfected the skills of their chosen class through ages of training and dedication.  I will guide you to one who can become your mentor, you have but to name your chosen path.
Oh, we are going to get along just fine, $n.
They're coming out of the woodwork today. Let's keep moving or we may find more things that want me dead.
